Secondary (templates only until 3.8 is green):

SHA256SUMS in each directory is the lockfile. Tokenizer bytes for 3.5/3.6
are intentionally not vendored yet — prefix accounting uses the 3.8 tokenizer
only, matching the "no cousin tokenizer" rule.
